claim_boundaries: Plants of the World Online provides current country-scale native/introduced status, not a historically dated native/introduced status of the specific study island during 2001–2010.
The country status is independent of the 2001–2010 GBIF plant-index observation; neither establishes shipment or propagule pathway.
Contemporary introduced status does not prove plants were introduced before or via the particular WPI harbor.
The plant's earlier GBIF record date is indexed observation, not original arrival or naturalization date.
Country status does not prove local larvae used the host or butterfly populations established.
biological_question: Whether introduced foodplant resource placement in islands, potentially linked with maritime transport, mediates the later geographic indexing of mobile butterflies.
